steps.prompt: Original heavyweight gladiator wrestler with a powerful but compact build: thick strong arms, broad shoulders, solid chest with lean flat sides (not bulky lats), shaved head, thick braided dark brown beard, tanned skin with old scars, one dark oiled leather strap crossing the chest from the right shoulder, wide studded leather belt, crimson red cloth loincloth over dark leather trunks, bronze knuckle gauntlets with short blunt studs on both fists, leather-wrapped shins and sandal boots, no shoulder armour. Photoreal studio render, physically based materials, real-world surface detail and wear, high detail. Single full-body figure, head to feet in frame with margin, centered, standing in an A-pose: both arms straight and angled down about 40 degrees away from the body with a wide clear gap between each arm and the torso, hands open and relaxed, legs straight and apart at shoulder width, feet flat pointing forward, front view facing the camera, even soft studio lighting, no cast shadow, plain light-grey seamless background. No text, no logos, no insignia, no watermark.

For a recognised humanoid run repair-skin --rebuild-limbs (rebuilds the legs in the skeleton's pose); otherwise rebuild the limbs in your DCC tool or regenerate and re-rig the model in the pose the skeleton assumes.
